new_warnings.detail: Function `public.get_my_event_participation_series(p_event_id uuid, p_from timestamp without time zone, p_to timestamp without time zone, p_bucket text)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/get_my_event_participation_series`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.
